summary: Standing 90 ft Aermotor tower in Monroe County, MS, registered by NHLR in July 2022; bottom stair flights were missing at the visit and the build date is unknown.

facts.design: 90 ft Aermotor tower with a parallel staircase, 13 landings and 14 flights

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 513 ft (156 m); OpenStreetMap gives 157 m. A one-metre gap that reads as rounding. The story uses the register figure.

sources.title: The Aermotor Company: From Windmills to Forest Lookout Towers

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR entry, the Wikipedia article (community and register listing), the Forest Lookouts index (name and county only) and the OSM node were usable. No build date, staffing, fire history or access information found. height_m is converted from the register's 90 ft. No access key set. The Grokipedia page in search results is AI-written and was not used. The brief's status standing is kept, with a status_note for the missing stair flights.
